compartment_definition: Marker-based compartments, not author Seurat/CopyKAT labels. Malignant-like = epithelial argmax AND zero UMI for SFTPA2/AGER/SCGB1A1/SCGB3A1/TPPP3.

paper_groups: TN=pre-biopsy (n=3); post MPR includes pCR P06 (n=4); post NMPR (n=8)
